title: Grimoire note template
description: A starting point for a campaign wiki page. See docs/note-templates.md for the authoring reference.

id.description: Stable unique identifier. Must match the containing directory name.

name.description: Display name in the template browser.

version.description: Semantic version. Bump on every change.

system.description: The game system this template is written for, e.g. 'D&D 5e'. Omit for a system-agnostic template.

category.description: Groups the template in the browser, e.g. 'Characters', 'Items', 'Spells', 'Encounters'.

description.description: One line, shown under the name.

body.description: The markdown file, relative to the template directory. Defaults to '<id>.md'.

attribution.description: Credit line, for a template adapted from a published source.
